body:
**Needs the maintainer's approval:** this PR changes user-facing documentation (`docs/user-guide.md`, the `needs-info` entry).

## Summary

The wording for a `needs-info` item now follows the spec (`triage.md` *Outcomes* and *Who answers*, `repository.md`'s label table). The item waits on a fact only a person knows, and the people asked answer it, not the reporter.

```diff
 # label::ALL (description of a needs-info label Linewright creates)
-Its assessment waits on a fact from the reporter
+Its assessment waits on a fact only a person knows

 # triage brief, step 4 Decide
-Facts come before decisions: while the reporter still owes a fact, choose
+Facts come before decisions: while a person still owes a fact only they
+know, choose

 # status of a needs-info item (lw status, web item page)
-ItemState::WaitingOnTheReporter  -> "waiting on the reporter"
+ItemState::WaitingOnThePeopleAsked -> "waiting on the people asked"
-Wait::Reporter  -> "the reporter: labeled `needs-info`"
+Wait::PeopleAsked -> "the people asked: labeled `needs-info`"

 # docs/user-guide.md
-`needs-info`: its assessment waits on a fact from the reporter.
+`needs-info`: its assessment waits on a fact only a person knows.
```

The board card still reads "reporter asked" (`CardLine::ReporterAsked`), because `design_system.md` specifies that text. `board.rs` changes only to use the renamed `ItemState` variant.

`Wait` is serialized with kebab-case tags, so in the local API's JSON a `needs-info` wait now reads `{"wait": "people-asked"}` where it used to read `{"wait": "reporter"}`. No spec or doc describes these tags.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the updated tests failed: `startup::` (label descriptions), `web::item::` ("state: waiting on the people asked", "waiting for: the people asked: labeled `needs-info`") and `reconcile::` (`Wait::PeopleAsked`). The reconcile tests did not compile, because `Wait::PeopleAsked` did not exist yet.
  **After:** `scripts/check` passes (fmt, markdown, compose, css, clippy, test, doc): 1043 tests run, 1043 passed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

An existing `needs-info` label keeps its old description; only labels Linewright creates from now on get the new one, as `repository.md` specifies.

**Blast Radius:** wording

This changes status text, one sentence in the triage brief, the description on new labels, and the local API's wait tag for `needs-info` (`reporter` becomes `people-asked`).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Closes #539
title: Describe needs-info as waiting on a fact only a person knows, from the people asked
